symptom: The vault Draft 2020-12 schema accepted -00:00 unknown-offset timestamps even after the runtime v108 admission guard rejected them, so schema-only consumers could grant unsupported point-in-time authority.
lesson: JSON Schema date-time format allows RFC3339 -00:00, so format validation alone does not enforce the research PIT requirement for a known UTC offset. Schema-only admission must be aligned with the runtime timestamp guard.
guardrail: Use one reusable exactInstant schema definition with a -00:00 rejection pattern for createdAt, enrollment start/end, enrolledAt and snapshot cutoffAt; retain date-time format and nullable endAt. Test both schema-only and runtime admission.
